properties.citation: al-Idrīsī, Nuzhat al-mushtāq fī ikhtirāq al-āfāq (1154), first climate, second section, on Ghana, in R. Dozy and M. J. de Goeje (eds., trans.), Description de l'Afrique et de l'Espagne par Edrîsî, Leiden, Brill, 1866, French translation p. 9: « Le pays de Ghana touche […] au nord au grand désert (Sahara) qui sépare le Soudan du pays des Berbers ». The gloss « (Sahara) » is the translators'. The translators render the Arabic name of this land as « Soudan »; the Arabic bilād al-sūdān means the land of the Blacks. Dinerstein, E., Olson, D., Joshi, A., et al. (2017). An Ecoregion-Based Approach to Protecting Half the Terrestrial Realm. BioScience 67 (6), 534–545. DOI 10.1093/biosci/bix014.
properties.derivation: Built by social/video/areas.mjs: the Ecoregions 2017 ecoregions Sahelian Acacia savanna, Inner Niger Delta flooded savanna, Lake Chad flooded savanna on Africa's land, outside the Sahara and west of the Nile; Africa's land is the union of the Natural Earth Admin 0 countries whose CONTINENT is Africa; « west of the Nile » keeps, on each grid row, the cells west of the westernmost crossing of the Natural Earth rivers named Nile, El Bahr el Abyad or Bahr el Jebel; north of the river's last vertex (the delta apex near Cairo) the apex longitude is used; on a 0.05° grid (cells whose centre falls inside), traced back as the cell boundary, simplified by Douglas–Peucker at 0.05° and rounded to 0.01°; parts and holes under 5000 km² dropped. This is EthniAfrica's reconstruction of a medieval description, not a border: al-Idrīsī drew no line between these lands. The Sahel stands for the belt south of the desert that the passage describes (Ghana, with the Lamlam to its south); the medieval Sudan also reached into the savanna further south, which al-Idrīsī knew only by hearsay.
